newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apple rated unattractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apple rated unattractive.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Andy Neff said he cut Apple Computer Inc to unattractive from hold and suspended his earnings estimates on the company "until we have better visibility on earnings."
-- Neff said the company's warning of a revenue shortfall and unexpected loss for the first quarter ended December 27 triggered the move.

-- But the Bear Stearns analyst said he also was concerned that the unexpectedly sharp decline in financial results comes at a time of confusion over Apple's future operating system plans and increasing competition from other PC makers.
-- Among the factors he cited were the introduction of rival PCs based on Intel Corp's MMX chip technology.
-- Neff had previously estimated Apple would earn $1.00 in fiscal 1997 and $1.50 in fiscal 1998.
